records.department: Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department / AP Seva
records.coverage: Andhra Pradesh; integrated community certificate services
records.description: AP Seva provides the citizen entry point for the integrated community, nativity and date-of-birth certificate service.
steps: Open AP Seva and choose Citizen Login.
Select Integrated Certificate and read the current instructions.
Keep the application reference for tracking.
conditions: This route covers the integrated certificate service; choose the applicable certificate type.

records.department: Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department / Village-Ward Secretariat
records.coverage: Andhra Pradesh; residence guidance published by Palnadu district
records.description: Official guidance explains general and passport-purpose residence certificates and the Village/Ward Secretariat or MeeSeva route.
steps: Read the guidance for the certificate type you need.
Use the Village/Ward Secretariat or MeeSeva route stated by the authority.
conditions: This is a guidance page, not an application form.
Confirm the issuing office for your address before applying.

records.department: Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department / Tahsildar
records.coverage: Andhra Pradesh; family-membership guidance published by Srikakulam district
records.description: The published administrative service is a Family Membership Certificate for specified government-employee benefits or social-security schemes.
steps: Check whether the stated service covers the benefit or claim.
Ask the relevant MeeSeva centre or Tahsildar about the appropriate application.
conditions: This administrative certificate must not be assumed to satisfy a court succession-certificate requirement.
This page provides guidance rather than an application form.

records.department: Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department
records.coverage: Land records for land in Andhra Pradesh
records.description: MeeBhoomi provides access to Andhra Pradesh land records and ownership-related entries.
steps: Choose the relevant land-record service in MeeBhoomi.
Use the correct district, village and parcel identifiers.
conditions: Viewing a land record is not an encumbrance-certificate application or a completed transfer.

records.department: Andhra Pradesh SERP / Rural Development Department
records.coverage: Eligible applicants and beneficiaries of Andhra Pradesh NTR Bharosa pension schemes
records.description: Official pension information, current notices, application-form downloads and disbursement information.
steps: Read the scheme and current application notices.
Use the published new-pension form and designated local application process.
conditions: Confirm the eligibility for the selected pension category.
The administrative login is not a general citizen application form.

records.department: Andhra Pradesh Public Grievance Redressal System
records.coverage: Andhra Pradesh state-government departments and public authorities
records.description: State grievance and follow-up channel for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: Choose the citizen grievance option and describe the unresolved issue.
Keep the grievance number for status and follow-up.
conditions: Use the relevant service application channel for a new certificate, benefit or approval.

contactPhone.purpose: Andhra Pradesh Public Grievance Redressal System

contactEmail.purpose: PGRS portal helpdesk; not a service-application inbox

records.department: Kerala Revenue Department / eDistrict
records.coverage: Kerala; selected revenue certificate and its jurisdiction
records.description: eDistrict lists caste, community, domicile and legal-heir certificate services.
steps: Read the selected certificate service details.
Use the citizen account or seek assistance through a service centre.
Keep the application number for tracking.
conditions: Requirements depend on the selected certificate and case.
An administrative legal-heir certificate is not a court succession certificate.

records.department: Kerala Revenue Department / ReLIS
records.coverage: Kerala; land services available for the relevant village
records.description: Revenue e-services provide access to ReLIS land-record and revenue services.
steps: Choose the relevant land-record service.
Confirm the village and land details before proceeding.
conditions: Use the separate Registration Department route for an encumbrance certificate.

records.department: Kerala Registration Department
records.coverage: Property within Kerala registration jurisdiction
records.description: Official encumbrance-certificate guidance from the Registration Department.
steps: Read the official encumbrance-certificate procedure.
Follow the department link to its PEARL application service.
conditions: This guidance page is not a submission form.
An EC request and a revenue-record transfer are separate services.

records.department: Kerala Local Self Government institutions / Sevana Pension
records.coverage: Eligible applicants and beneficiaries of Kerala social-security pension schemes
records.description: Sevana publishes pension schemes, forms, beneficiary information and current notices.
steps: Choose the relevant scheme and read the current criteria and form.
Use the listed e-filing option or the applicable local-government process.
conditions: The selected scheme and local-government authority determine the application process.

records.department: Kerala Chief Minister Public Grievance Redressal Cell
records.coverage: Kerala state-government departments and public authorities
records.description: State grievance and follow-up channel for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: Use the online complaint portal, Akshaya centre or another option stated in the FAQ.
Keep the docket number and registered mobile number to check status.
conditions: The official FAQ says complaints cannot be filed by phone or email. The phone contact is for help, status and follow-up.
Use the relevant application service for new certificates, benefits or approvals.

contactPhone.purpose: CM grievance help, status and follow-up; not phone complaint registration

records.department: West Bengal Backward Classes Welfare Department
records.coverage: West Bengal; eligible applicants for the selected SC/ST/OBC certificate
records.description: OSCAR is the official caste-certificate application and tracking portal.
steps: Read the current application guidelines.
Choose the certificate and residential jurisdiction.
Save the application acknowledgement.
conditions: Choose the correct certificate category and current rules for your case.

records.department: West Bengal eDistrict / responsible local issuing authority
records.coverage: West Bengal; local residence or domicile certificate services
records.description: eDistrict supports residence/domicile certificate services; Bangla Sahayata Kendras also list this service.
steps: Select the residence/domicile service or seek help at a Bangla Sahayata Kendra.
Confirm the certificate format and issuing jurisdiction.
conditions: The receiving authority may require a particular certificate format.

records.department: West Bengal Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department
records.coverage: Land records and listed land services in West Bengal
records.description: BanglarBhumi provides Record of Rights, plot information, mutation and related citizen services.
steps: Select the relevant citizen land service and sign in when required.
Confirm property identifiers and retain the application reference.
conditions: A land-record or mutation service is not a court succession proceeding.

contactPhone.purpose: Directorate of Land Records and Survey contact

contactEmail.purpose: Land Records and Survey grievance-cell contact

records.department: West Bengal Finance Department / administering social-pension department
records.coverage: West Bengal social-pension schemes covered by Jai Bangla
records.description: Jai Bangla is the umbrella social-pension portal and provides applicant-status access.
steps: Identify the pension scheme and administering department.
Use applicant-status access for an existing application or confirm the application route with the authority.
conditions: The public applicant-status feature is not a new-pension application form.
Eligibility and application routes depend on the scheme.

records.department: West Bengal Chief Minister Office / public grievance system
records.coverage: West Bengal state-government departments and public authorities
records.description: State grievance and follow-up channel for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: Open Citizen Corner and choose Raise Your Grievance.
Keep the grievance reference for status and follow-up.
conditions: Use the options currently published by the CMO. The helpdesk is not a benefit-application route.

records.department: Digital Gujarat / relevant revenue or civil-supplies authority
records.coverage: Gujarat; the certificate or ration-card service selected in Digital Gujarat
records.description: Digital Gujarat offers caste, domicile and ration-card services online and through assisted counters.
steps: Choose the specific citizen service.
Read that service and use the online account or an authorised assistance counter.
conditions: Choose the service matching your case; the portal does not establish eligibility by itself.

records.department: Gujarat Revenue Department / e-Dhara
records.coverage: Gujarat land-record and mutation-status information
records.description: AnyROR provides land-record information and mutation-entry status. e-Dhara and the competent revenue office handle relevant changes.
steps: Choose the appropriate rural or urban record option.
For changes or a required certified copy, follow the revenue authority process.
conditions: A viewed record or status result is not a newly issued EC or completed transfer.

records.department: Gujarat Director of Social Defense
records.coverage: Gujarat; Niradhar Vriddha Pension Yojana applicants meeting the published criteria
records.description: Guidance for the state destitute-old-age pension, including its specified disability-related eligibility provision.
steps: Read the scheme-specific eligibility.
Use the listed Jan Seva Kendra, Mamlatdar office, Gram Panchayat or Digital Gujarat route.
conditions: This record covers the named scheme, not every old-age, widow or disability benefit.

records.department: Gujarat Women and Child Development Department
records.coverage: Gujarat; widow-pension application guidance
records.description: The department publishes an official Widow Pension Form in its application-form directory.
steps: Find the Widow Pension Form.
Confirm the current submission procedure with the administering office.
conditions: This is a form directory, not an online pension submission form.

records.department: Gujarat Chief Minister Office / SWAGAT
records.coverage: Gujarat; eligible unresolved grievances already raised with the appropriate authority
records.description: State grievance follow-up for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: First approach the relevant department or district/sub-district authority.
For an unresolved eligible grievance, follow SWAGAT instructions and retain its reference.
conditions: SWAGAT eligibility requires that the grievance was already presented to the appropriate authority and remains unresolved.
Use the relevant application service for new certificates, benefits or approvals.

records.department: Rajasthan Revenue Department / eMitra
records.coverage: Rajasthan; selected caste or bonafide/residence certificate services
records.description: eMitra provides caste and bonafide/residence certificate services and assisted service delivery.
steps: Choose the exact certificate service through eMitra or its assisted route.
Read the current instructions and retain the acknowledgement.
conditions: The certificate category and purpose determine the applicable service.

records.department: Rajasthan Board of Revenue / Apna Khata
records.coverage: Agricultural land records and listed land services in Rajasthan
records.description: Apna Khata provides Jamabandi information, mutation applications and status services.
steps: Choose the land-record or mutation service.
Enter the correct land identifiers and retain any application reference.
conditions: The site states that ordinary displayed Jamabandi information is not an authorised certified copy. Use the prescribed kiosk process when a certified copy is required.

records.department: Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department / RajSSP
records.coverage: Rajasthan social-security pension schemes; eligibility is scheme-specific
records.description: RajSSP publishes pension information, eligibility criteria, reports and verification guidance.
steps: Read the appropriate pension scheme and eligibility criteria.
Use the published application or yearly-verification route for your task.
conditions: The administrative login is not a general citizen application form. Confirm the designated application route.

records.department: Rajasthan Public Grievance Redressal Department / Sampark
records.coverage: Rajasthan state-government departments and public authorities
records.description: State grievance and follow-up channel for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: Use Sampark to lodge or follow up a state-government grievance.
Keep the grievance reference for further contact.
conditions: For another state or a central-government organisation, follow the CPGRAMS direction published by Sampark.
Use the relevant application service for new certificates, benefits or approvals.

records.department: Madhya Pradesh eDistrict / competent revenue authority
records.coverage: Madhya Pradesh; selected caste and domicile certificate services
records.description: eDistrict provides certificate services online and through Lok Seva Kendra assistance.
steps: Choose the certificate in eDistrict or seek help at a Lok Seva Kendra.
Confirm the service and retain its acknowledgement.
conditions: Requirements depend on the selected certificate and competent authority.

records.department: Madhya Pradesh Revenue Department / Commissioner Land Records
records.coverage: Land records and listed land services in Madhya Pradesh
records.description: Bhulekh provides land records, maps and certified-copy services. The current GIS 2.0 destination is linked by official district administration.
steps: Choose the land-record or copy service.
Check the district, village and parcel details.
conditions: Use the designated certified-copy service when an authorised copy is required.

records.department: Madhya Pradesh Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department
records.coverage: Madhya Pradesh; listed social-security pension and assistance schemes
records.description: The Social Security portal lists old-age, widow and disability pensions and related online services.
steps: Select the pension scheme matching your enquiry.
Read its criteria and use the relevant citizen or local-body process.
conditions: Scheme-specific eligibility applies. Administrative modules are intended for authorised officials.

records.department: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Management / CM Helpline
records.coverage: Madhya Pradesh state-government departments and public authorities
records.description: State grievance and follow-up channel for unresolved public-service issues. It does not submit a new service application.
steps: Use the portal or 181 to report a grievance about a state-government service.
Keep the complaint number for status and follow-up.
conditions: Read the online complaint exclusions before submitting. A grievance does not replace a judicial proceeding.
Use the relevant application service for new certificates, benefits or approvals.

contactPhone.purpose: CM Helpline from within Madhya Pradesh

contactEmail.purpose: CM Helpline contact; use the portal or 181 for registration
